import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    runs = []
    n = len(s)
    length = 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        if s[i] == s[i-1]:
            length += 1
        else:
            runs.append(length)
            length = 1
    runs.append(length)
    ans = 0
    for r in runs:
        if r % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
